principles: one active QR token maps to one table
rotation invalidates the current token immediately
the immediately previous token remains recoverable and can be restored explicitly
QR rotation and Public-origin rebind are distinct lifecycle events
operators preview and test the current QR before printing
bulk download is generated only from active current table QR bindings
rotation and restore are audited with actor and timestamp
printed QR validity must never be inferred after a Public URL/origin change
